title: Rolling Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Metal and Plastic
description: Set up, operate, or tend machines to roll steel or plastic forming bends, beads, knurls, rolls, or plate, or to flatten, temper, or reduce gauge of material.

tasks.text: Monitor machine cycles and mill operation to detect jamming and to ensure that products conform to specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Adjust and correct machine set-ups to reduce thicknesses, reshape products, and eliminate product defects.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Start operation of rolling and milling machines to flatten, temper, form, and reduce sheet metal sections and to produce steel strips.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Metal and plastic forming equipment run by hand

dwas.name: Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Examine, inspect, and measure raw materials and finished products to verify conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Inspect metal, plastic, or composite products.
Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Read rolling orders, blueprints, and mill schedules to determine setup specifications, work sequences, product dimensions, and installation procedures.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Study blueprints or other instructions to determine equipment setup requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Manipulate controls and observe dial indicators to monitor, adjust, and regulate speeds of machine mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.
Operate metal or plastic forming equipment.

tasks.text: Set distance points between rolls, guides, meters, and stops, according to specifications.

dwas.name: Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Calculate draft space and roll speed for each mill stand to plan rolling sequences and specified dimensions and tempers.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Production requirement calc; human validates inputs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.

tasks.text: Install equipment such as guides, guards, gears, cooling equipment, and rolls, using hand tools.

dwas.name: Install mechanical components in production equipment.

tasks.text: Position, align, and secure arbors, spindles, coils, mandrels, dies, and slitting knives.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Fill oil cups, adjust valves, and observe gauges to control flow of metal coolants and lubricants onto workpieces.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Instrument monitoring needs physical sensor presence

dwas.name: Monitor instruments to ensure proper production conditions.
Adjust equipment controls to regulate coolant flow.

tasks.text: Activate shears and grinders to trim workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Reshape metal workpieces to established specifications.
Operate grinding equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Signal and assist other workers to remove and position equipment, fill hoppers, and feed materials into machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Embodied signaling in shared physical workspace

dwas.name: Signal others to coordinate work activities.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others

tasks.text: Record mill production on schedule sheets.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Direct and train other workers to change rolls, operate mill equipment, remove coils and cobbles, and band and load material.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.
Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Thread or feed sheets or rods through rolling mechanisms, or start and control mechanisms that automatically feed steel into rollers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Select rolls, dies, roll stands, and chucks from data charts to form specified contours and to fabricate products.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Remove scratches and polish roll surfaces, using polishing stones and electric buffers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual polishing of workpieces requires dexterity

dwas.name: Polish materials, workpieces, or finished products.

tasks.text: Disassemble sizing mills removed from rolling lines, and sort and store parts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical product sorting needs manipulation in warehouse

dwas.name: Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.
Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.
